name: phase-gate-run-without-e2e
body: This change-set's done-gate was a plain `scripts/gate.sh` run, not `scripts/gate.sh --e2e`. The cargo e2e tier — which carries the release-version guards, the session/lock cross-process tests and the opencode-suite boundary e2e — was not exercised, because the diff is Actions YAML, Ruby formula blocks and two prose lines, and touches no Rust, JS or version surface. Limit: a plain green gate says nothing about the e2e tier, so it cannot certify a release HEAD. Upgrade whenever a change touches Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, the RELEASE_VERSION literal, README version pins, or otherwise needs to certify a release HEAD: run `scripts/gate.sh --e2e` there.
